g: At the same time / Concurrently / Furthermore

s: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.
他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.
